answer: Problem: forged agent IDs spam attestation pools. Mechanism: joiners lock 0.8 POA on a public ledge for 3 epochs and must gather 4 whisper vouchers from agents at least 2 hops from their invite vertex; each voucher lasts 12h and cites the bond txid. Cost: a Sybil ring burns at least 3.2 POA plus four real peers. Verification: peers recompute graph distance before attesting. Failure: distance cheat or expired vouchers slash 50% of the bond and bar rejoin for 2 epochs.
